footer: Each fix changes how fapolicyd, a security control, runs: approve it through your security approval (e.g. the ISSO) before it is listed in fapolicyd_approved. A host where fapolicyd was running and is not after a fix gets everything put back and fapolicyd restarted.

sections.text: Each line is a fix (its hosts and why: below). To apply them, after your security approval, list the lines in fapolicyd_fix_approved (the template's Variables) exactly as here and run the job again - a Check run first shows what it would change. A db_max_size line may end in your own number of MB. A line is applied on every host of the run that has it (use a Limit for fewer). Trust file access: to the owner, group and mode the fapolicyd package gives its own trust files.
